definitions.explanation: Ahead of others in development, technology, or ideas. Describes something that is at the forefront of progress or innovation.

examples.japanese: {先進的|せんしんてき}な{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{導入|どうにゅう}した。
その{取|と}り{組|く}みは{先進的|せんしんてき}だと{評価|ひょうか}された。
examples.english: The initiative was praised as cutting-edge.

examples.japanese: この{都市|とし}は{環境|かんきょう}{政策|せいさく}で{世界|せかい}でも{先進的|せんしんてき}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: This city plays a pioneering role in environmental policy even on the world stage.

notes:
Formed from {先進|せんしん} (advance, progress) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix). Used to praise something as being at the leading edge of technology, policy, or thought.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先進的|せんしんてき}な{技術|ぎじゅつ}: advanced technology
- {先進的|せんしんてき}な{取|と}り{組|く}み: pioneering initiative
- {先進的|せんしんてき}な{研究|けんきゅう}: cutting-edge research
- {先進的|せんしんてき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}: progressive way of thinking
- {先進的|せんしんてき}な{事例|じれい}: advanced example/case study

RELATED WORDS:
- {先進国|せんしんこく}: developed country, advanced nation
- {先進|せんしん}: advance, being ahead — the base noun

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {革新的|かくしんてき}: innovative, revolutionary — emphasizes breaking new ground or overturning the status quo
- {最先端|さいせんたん}: state-of-the-art, cutting-edge — emphasizes being at the very forefront
- {進歩的|しんぽてき}: progressive — often used for social or political views
